If you disable or delete the key that you used to encrypt a domain, the domain becomes
inaccessible. OpenSearch Service sends you a notiﬁcation informing you that it can't access the
KMS key. Re-enable the key immediately to access your domain.
Encryption at rest
1296
Amazon OpenSearch Service
Developer Guide
The OpenSearch Service team can't help you recover your data if your key is deleted. AWS KMS
deletes keys only after a waiting period of at least seven days. If your key is pending deletion,
either cancel deletion or take a manual snapshot of the domain to prevent loss of data.
